INSERT INTO portfolio.source_file (engagement_id, file_name, file_type, sha256_hash, row_count, source_path)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
ON CONFLICT (engagement_id, sha256_hash) DO UPDATE SET row_count = EXCLUDED.row_count
RETURNING file_id, file_name, intake_status, (xmax = 0) AS newly_received
